name: Compressor drivers, sealing and auxiliary systems
description: Provide shaft power, prevent process-gas leakage to atmosphere, and support lube/seal-oil and capacity control. On offshore platforms electric motors or gas turbines are most common; steam turbines are offered as integrated drivers on some turbo compressors.

specifications.basis: Howden steam turbines 75 kW to 40 MWe; mechanical drive for rotating equipment 10 kW to 40 MW; inlet pressures to 70 bar
Howden/CPI EMISSIONGUARD TR2 packing rings stated to have prevented an estimated 20,173,000 Nm3 (693,144,000 scf) of vented gas, equivalent to 60,500 t CO2
Howden lists N2 buffer system per API 618 and 'compressor improvements API 618' in revamp services
